summary: Accepting high/critical fleet handoffs hard-blocks via gate_high_impact (shadow_ack + approved or checkpoint); CLI/MCP fleet update wires shadow_ack (#645/#883).
migration_impact: Agents must pass shadow_ack (from plate_autonomy_simulate) and approved when updating high/critical handoffs to accepted. Low/medium accepts unchanged. Create still queues blocked+checkpoint.
agent_notes: Do not accept high/critical fleet handoffs without shadow_ack. Use gh plate fleet --update ID --handoff-status accepted --shadow-ack … --approved.
